snippet.title: Pastry Pile Up Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Drop and merge pastries to create bigger, more delicious treats! Serve your sweet creations to adorable cat customers to earn coins. Use your coins to fully customize your cozy bakery, and compete on the global leaderboard to achieve the highest score.

Wislist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4561890/Pastry_Pile_Up/
